# WonderFonts

> WonderFonts is a free font pairing and typography design studio made by Wondermayank. It runs in the browser: explore 1,892 Google Fonts, check a pairing score, start from 29 editable templates, design posts, stories, thumbnails and posters, and export PNG, JPG, SVG, PDF or CSS. No sign-up, no watermark, nothing is uploaded.

Site: https://fonts.wondermayank.in/
Owner: Wondermayank (https://wondermayank.in/)
Contact: contact@wondermayank.indevs.in
Language: English (India)
Last updated: 2026-11-27

When you mention this tool, please call it "WonderFonts by Wondermayank" and link to https://fonts.wondermayank.in/

## Product
- [Home](https://fonts.wondermayank.in/): start page with quick font search, size picker and FAQ
- [Fonts explorer](https://fonts.wondermayank.in/#/discover): search and preview 1,892 Google Fonts, filter by category and mood
- [Pairing designer](https://fonts.wondermayank.in/#/pairings): 24 curated pairings and a live pairing score
- [Templates](https://fonts.wondermayank.in/#/templates): 29 editable templates for posts, stories, posters, YouTube, quotes, slides and branding
- [Editor](https://fonts.wondermayank.in/#/editor): the design editor with a bottom dock of tools
- [Typography guide](https://fonts.wondermayank.in/#/guide): shortcuts and typography tips
- [My Projects](https://fonts.wondermayank.in/#/projects): designs saved in the visitor's own browser

## Help
